core: Both communities assign, before the evaluation run itself, a fixed reference value for a task (a reread/reopen cap in one case, a difficulty or expected-failure threshold set by annotators in the other), and then use that pre-set value afterward to judge whether an agent's failure on the task is an ordinary outcome consistent with expectations or an anomaly worth separate investigation, rather than treating every failure as equivalent evidence of poor performance.
quote_1: Spent Monday convinced our ⟦T1⟧ enforcement had silently broken, because three agents that used to pass the file-navigation suite started failing en masse.
quote_2: Failures below an agent’s ⟦T2⟧ were flagged for audit rather than treated as ordinary misses.
